repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t = (#Living_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("The living room is " + t + " degrees")

diagnosis.summary: JoI uses Korean text '거실 온도는 도입니다' while IR specifies English 'The living room is $t degrees'. F2 shows action argument mismatch: IR has English text with variable placeholder, JoI has Korean text with same placeholder pattern. The variable t must be interpolated into English message.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed speaker_speak text from Korean to English matching IR specification. Preserves all(#Speaker) selector, variable interpolation, and one-shot period. Message now reads 'The living room is ' + t + ' degrees' with t substituted at runtime.
